purpose: Separate ASR/whole-JSON wait, first TTS, per-packet authorized emission, software sink first sample, sentence starvation and complete ACK/rearm
source: existing passive metadata only after root frontend trial; at most 20 already completed turns, or omit when unavailable
scene_correction: Root reports v11 turns were triggered by surrounding speech/playback while the user was NOT actively testing. Label those existing rounds ENVIRONMENT_ONLY; normal complete ACK/rearm is not by itself a fault or human acceptance.
already_available_source_pins: 375-pin baseline_manifest.json is already reviewed. No duplicate board read is needed unless the root has selected a newer revision.

sanitize.unknown_fields: drop before writing; do not serialize raw runtime snapshots
sanitize.identifiers: replace all per-turn identity/owner keys with local round_index 1..20; never output real text, PCM, hashes of text, profile ids, DB paths, request/session/capture ids, or raw exception class/message
sanitize.time: durations or offsets within one board monotonic clock only; null when missing; do not subtract board and Windows timestamps
sanitize.version_output: numeric version only from already available metadata; no import, service call or process launch necessary for this request

allowed_round_fields.test_context_authority: operator-provided scene label only, never inferred from ASR text, a completed ACK or successful model output
allowed_round_fields.vad_last_speech_ms: board offset or null; VAD proxy, not human acoustic ground truth
allowed_round_fields.first_tts_ready_ms: board offset from SAME round origin, not controller-relative value mislabeled as round-relative; null if conversion unavailable
allowed_round_fields.first_answer_sink_ms: first positive answer sink position observation on board clock or null; SOFTWARE estimate, never acoustic first sound

optional_supply_metadata.root_instrumentation_required: If no existing per-packet arrival metadata exists, omit; do not add hot-path logging for this request
optional_supply_metadata.bound: max 1500 packet records for one turn, then aggregate; no PCM
optional_supply_metadata.arrival_ms: nondecreasing same-board-clock offset at authorized progress enqueue AFTER fresh guard; not Windows TTS completion time
optional_supply_metadata.purpose: Offline replay of 0/80/160/240ms start reserve; cannot prove soundcard continuity

if_unavailable: Return fixed UNAVAILABLE and field names only. Research/candidates continue without it. Missing values must remain null and must not be synthesized from another turn.
